verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Thank you, Lord,
For the trials that come my way

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In that way I can grow each day
As I let you lead

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And thank you, Lord
For the patience those trials bring

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
In that process of growing
I can learn to care

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
But it goes against the way
I am to put my human nature down

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And let the Spirit take
control of all I do.

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
'Cause when those trials come
My human nature
Shouts the thing to do

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
And God's soft prompting
can be easily ignored

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I thank you, Lord
With each trial I feel inside

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: That you're there to help lead and guide me away from wrong

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
'Cause you promised, Lord
That with every testing

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
That your way of escaping
Is easier to bear

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
I thank you, Lord
For the victory that growing brings

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
In surrender of everything
Life is so worth while

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
And I thank you, Lord
That when everything's put in place

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines:
Out in front I can see your face
And it's there you belong
